jobs.title: Business Development Onboarding & Training Specialist
jobs.description:
About Filevine
Filevine is the leading legal work platform, transforming the way legal teams operate. Our mission is to empower legal professionals with seamless tools that enhance productivity, professionalism, and performance. Join a team that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth.
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced and passionate BDR Onboarding & Training Manager to lead the design, delivery, and optimization of onboarding and ongoing training programs for our Business Development Representatives (BDRs). This individual will own the end-to-end onboarding experience, mentor program, upskilling curriculum, and BDR training strategy across all stages of the funnel, products, and verticals.

You’ll be responsible for ensuring BDRs ramp quickly, gain deep knowledge of our product, process, and personas, and maintain excellence through engaging and high-impact enablement.
Key Responsibilities
Onboarding Program Management

-
Design and execute a world-class, repeatable 2-week BDR onboarding program monthly.

-
Build curriculum that covers tools (Salesforce, Gong, SalesLoft, ZoomInfo, Sales Nav, 6Sense, GTM Buddy), writing and soft skills, sales methodology, professionalism, and product knowledge.

-
Facilitate live (in-person/virtual) sessions and manage asynchronous learning via GTM Buddy.

-
Conduct live call coaching and provide feedback using Gong and other engagement tools.

-
Set clear expectations and success metrics for all new BDRs.

Ongoing BDR Training & Enablement

-
Create and deliver coaching programs to improve SQL > SAL conversion.

-
Run 1:1 and group coaching, performance clinics, and targeted enablement sprints.

-
Collaborate with AE Enablement to create certifications and training tailored to verticals, personas, and product lines for BDR.

-
Create new cadence strategies for different practice areas or product launches.

Mentorship Program Oversight

-
Develop and manage the BDR Mentor Program, including mentor selection, training, performance tracking, and weekly check-ins.

-
Define and enforce program standards, ensuring mentors drive measurable impact.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

-
Track and report on ramp time, training NPS, call quality, and qualification metrics.

-
Analyze performance data to iterate on onboarding and enablement content.

-
Maintain high standards of program engagement, completion, and impact.

What Success Looks Like

-
Reduced BDR ramp time and increased pipeline contribution within the first 90 days.

-
Higher conversion rates from SQL to SAL for ramped BDRs.

-
High training satisfaction scores (NPS).

-
Consistently positive mentor feedback and mentee performance improvement.

-
Strong cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Product, and Marketing Enablement teams.
Qualifications
Must-Have Experience

-
3+ years in Sales Enablement, BDR/BDR training, or sales leadership (preferably in SaaS).

-
Experience developing and facilitating training programs for inbound and outbound sales.

-
Strong instructional design skills and experience with adult learning principles.

-
Deep understanding of B2B SaaS sales tools (e.g., Salesforce, SalesLoft, Gong, GTM Buddy).

-
Exceptional facilitation, coaching, and communication skills.

Bonus Points

-
Prior experience in a quota-carrying BDR or AE role.

-
Familiarity with legal tech or complex, multi-persona sales cycles.

-
Experience designing certification paths and persona-based enablement strategies.

-
Background in instructional design or learning & development.

Your duties will include motivating our sales team, designing strategic sales plans, and equipping reps with the skills and support to achieve the goals outlined by the business. In addition to being an excellent communicator, our ideal candidate will also demonstrate exceptional leadership and relationship-building skills, including the ability to influence across teams, onboarding, coaching, employee development, advocating, and decision-making.

Filevine is scaling our legal AI ecosystem, technology integrations, channel relationships, and strategic AI alliances. We're looking for a senior partnerships leader who can build and run that ecosystem end to end: designing programs, personally establishing marquee strategic partnership deals, and standing up a team to scale the function. This is a builder's role for someone who wants ownership of the whole partner landscape.

Core Responsibilities
-
Set the Partnerships Strategy: Build and own Filevine’s end-to-end ecosystem strategy (channel and reseller, technology and ISV integrations, and strategic AI/cloud alliances, global system integrators and university partnerships)

-
Secure Strategic & AI Alliances: Personally develop, negotiate and secure high-value integrations and alliances.

-
Build the Platform & Channel Programs: Stand up a scalable channel, referral, and API/ISV partner programs (including but not limited to certification, marketplace presence, and co-sell / co-marketing enablement).

-
Own Partner-Sourced Revenue: Set and defend pipeline and revenue targets tied to partner activity, and report on ecosystem health and ROI at the executive level.

-
Drive Cross-Functional Execution: Partner closely with Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance and Legal to make sure integrations ship, partner deals convert to pipeline, and contracts protect Filevine’s interests.

-
Build and Lead the Team: As the partner ecosystem gains traction, hire, mentor, and structure a team spanning channel management, alliances, and partner enablement.
What You'll Need to Succeed:
-
Proven Track Record: 10+ years in partnerships, business development, or channel leadership, including experience personally negotiating and closing strategic technology or ecosystem deals (not just managing an inherited channel program) and nurtured those relationships to be actively producing

-
Builder's Mindset: Experience designing a partnerships function from an earlier stage of maturity, and comfort operating across both channel/reseller motions and complex strategic alliance negotiations.

-
Executive Presence: Strong track record communicating ecosystem strategy and results to a CRO, CEO, or board.

-
Location: Based in or near Salt Lake City, Chicago, San Francisco, New York or open to remote for the right candidate.

-
Team building: Proven experience hiring, coaching, or leading a partnerships or business development team.

About the Role 
Filevine is expanding in New York, and we need a strategic leader who understands the nuance of the city’s top law firms. This is ideal for a former attorney who wants to move away from traditional practice and focus on relationship-building, market strategy, and growth. You’ll connect us with decision-makers at major firms, build out a network of trusted advisors, and pave the way to build a regional team down the line.

Core Responsibilities: 
-
Shape the NY Strategy: Build and execute our go-to-market plan for the New York market, setting long-term goals for growth across BigLaw, AmLaw, NLJ 500, and large general-practice firms.

-
Cultivate High-Impact Relationships: Develop a strong network of referral partners, consultants, and advisors whose introductions give Filevine a seat at the table. Your connections and industry standing will be the primary engine driving our presence forward.

-
Create & Expand Opportunities: Identify key enterprise opportunities, land initial footholds in practice groups or regional offices, and build the relationships needed to expand across entire firms over time.

-
Maintain Deal Momentum: Partner closely with our Strategic Accounts team, keeping executive relationships warm and aligned as opportunities progress toward close. (This role focuses on relationship leadership and vision, leaving technical demos and redlines to dedicated account executives.)

-
Build and Lead the Local Team: As the New York motion gains traction, you will hire, mentor, and structure a dedicated team of sellers and relationship managers to scale our regional footprint.

-
Represent the New York Market: Work side-by-side with internal sales, marketing, product, and customer success teams to serve as the voice of New York’s legal community within Filevine.
What You'll Need to Succeed: 
-
Legal Background: 10+ years as an attorney, partner or managing partner inside an AmLaw, BigLaw, or comparable large firm setting.

-
Established Local Network: Strong existing relationships in and around the New York legal market, along with the credibility to continuously broaden your reach.

-
Hands-On Leadership Style: Comfort rolling up your sleeves to personally drive early strategy and relationship-building before building and managing a larger team.

- JD (Juris Doctor) required

-
Location: Based in or near New York City.
Nice to Have: 
-
Prior business development, sales, or partnership experience in legal tech or professional services.

-
A strong grasp of modern legal technology and the operational dynamics of large law firms.

-
Proven experience hiring, coaching, or leading client-facing teams.
